notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Eternal Witness and the two creatures your opponents own, adding {1}{B}{B}.
When the three creatures die, Headless Rider triggers three times, creating three 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombies, adding {2}.
Repeat.
